description.value: Anna's Cake House is a family-owned Hong Kong-style bakery founded in 1974 by Anna, Ronald, and Kathleen Cheung, now celebrating 50 years of baking. The Burnaby location at Lougheed Mall is one of four Greater Vancouver outposts offering freshly baked cakes and buns made daily with no artificial additives. Known for its Hong Kong-style buns and made-to-order fresh cream cakes in over 15 flavours, it has become a community institution with a multigenerational following.
